title: DCRLR/38/2007 of MOHAN SINGH Vs STATE AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
DCRLR No.38/07
Honíble Dharam Veer J.
(Delay Condonation Appl. No. Nil/2007)
Sri S.K. Mandal and Sri Mohd. Matloob, learned counsels
for the revisionist and Sri Harish Pujari, learned Addl. GA for the
State, are present.
 I have perused the application filed by learned counsel for
the revisionist. There is delay of 88 days in filing the revision.
The grounds shown in the affidavit filed along with the delay
condonation application are sufficient to condone the delay. The
delay in filling the revision has been explained by sufficient
cause.
 The delay condonation application is allowed. Delay is
hereby condoned.
 I have also perused the judgment and order dated
11.05.2007 passed by Juvenile Justice Board, Nainital in
Criminal Case No.05/2004, State Vs. Lalu.
 Admit.
 Summon the record from trial court.
 Learned Addl. GA has accepted notice on behalf of
respondent no.1.
 Issue notice to respondent no.2 returnable within four
weeks.
 List thereafter in due course.
(Dharam Veer J.)
 18.06.2008
